message.content:
This is a CBP ruling on collapsible textile storage bins. The likely classification is 6307.90.9889 (other made up articles of textile materials), though it could also be 4202.92 (storage cases with outer surface of textile materials). Storage bins are not designed for carrying personal effects like luggage, and CBP has generally classified collapsible fabric storage bins in 6307.90.98. The bins are made of woven polyester fabric coated with PE, and the "other" subheading is 6307.90.9889.

The ruling is for sets of two, but the bins are not a retail "set" of different articles, so the classification is the same either way. Chapter 39 does not apply, because the textile fabric is the predominant material. Chapter 63 covers made up textile articles and 6307.90 covers "other", so 6307.90.9889 is the best fit.
